sentences.text: The 2nd respondent is her husband and the accused in the said case.
The offences alleged against the 2nd respondent are under Sections 406 and 498A of the IPC.
The allegation is that the husband of the defacto complainant subjected her to cruelty and appropriated her gold ornaments.
2. Now, the petitioner submits that she does not wish to proceed with the case any further.

Since this is a case involving a matrimonial dispute and the offences alleged are under Sections 406 and 498A of the IPC and as the defacto complainant herself has approached this Court seeking to quash the proceedings against the 2 nd respondent, I am inclined to allow this petition.
In the result, this Crl.M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the 2nd respondent in C.C No.
620 of 2023 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court- IV, Kozhikode, is quashed.
